name: Shiina Inori
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c12570]Taisuke's[/url] underclassman in school. She hangs around Taisuke and [url=http://vndb.org/c12577]Ryuu[/url] at school and shares lunch with them in the cafeteria. Although they're good friends Ryuu shows no interest in her because she has breasts.

[spoiler]In the extended side story she gives birth to Taisuke's daughter and becomes pregnant again with his second child.[/spoiler]
